item.text:
Extracted the async loading/error/abort plumbing into a reusable hook and made `useComments` a thin adapter.

- [frontend/src/useAsyncData.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/src/useAsyncData.js#L1) now owns the generic fetch lifecycle, including `AbortController` handling and status transitions.
- [frontend/src/useComments.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/src/useComments.js#L1) now just fetches comments and maps the generic async state to `comments`.

Validation:
- `node --check` passed for `frontend/src/useAsyncData.js`, `frontend/src/useComments.js`, `frontend/src/api.js`, and `frontend/src/formatters.js`.
- `git diff --check` is clean.

If you want another pass, the next clean refactor would be either:
1. Add a matching `useAsyncData` consumer for any future API calls so the hook gets reused.
2. Trim the remaining model bootstrap boilerplate in `backend/models/index.js`.
